derive available(partner:Partner,currency:currency):money = sum(partner.Sale as sale where sale.commission.currency==currency select sale.commission,currency)+sum(partner.Adjustment as adjustment where adjustment.amount.currency==currency select adjustment.amount,currency)-sum(partner.Settlement as settlement where settlement.amount.currency==currency and settlement.allocation in [pending,unknown,allocated] select settlement.amount,currency)
policy Partner read=partner_manager or finance where=all(row.locations as location,can_work(actor,location))

crud Partner by=partner_manager fields=name,email,locations,products,rate,agreement,milestone,active create_fields=name,account,email,locations,products,rate,agreement,milestone when=all(row.locations as location,can_work(actor,location)) delete=none

lines.source: scenario settle(partner:Partner,amount:money) by=finance label="Settle commission"@{nl="Commissie verrekenen"}

require all(partner.locations as location,can_work(actor,location)) and partner.active and partner.onboarded and partner.provider_account!=null and amount.minor>0 and amount<=available(partner,amount.currency)
for partner in Partner as row where row.id==event.value.attribution and row.active limit=1
let existing=first(partner.Sale as sale where sale.source==event.value.source order=sale.id)
if existing!=null and event.value.milestone==reversed and not existing.reversed
for settlement in Settlement as row where row.source==event.source limit=1
for settlement in Settlement as row where row.allocation in [pending,unknown] or row.bank in [pending,in_transit] limit=100

derive available(calendar:Calendar,from:datetime,until:datetime):bool = is_open(calendar.location,from,until) and from<until and local_date(from,calendar.timezone)==local_date(until-1ms,calendar.timezone) and any(calendar.WeeklyHours as hours,hours.weekday==weekday(local_date(from,calendar.timezone)) and local_instant(local_date(from,calendar.timezone),hours.opens,calendar.timezone,fold=hours.fold)<=from and until<=local_instant(local_date(from,calendar.timezone),hours.closes,calendar.timezone,fold=hours.fold)) and not any(calendar.ClosedDay as closure,closure.day==local_date(from,calendar.timezone)) and any(calendar.Window as window,window.available and window.from<=from and until<=window.until) and not any(calendar.Window as window,not window.available and overlaps(from,until,window.from,window.until))

if event.status==succeeded and event.result!=null and event.result.source==job.source and event.result.revision==job.schedule_revision and event.result.state==confirmed
if event.status==failed or (event.status==succeeded and event.result!=null and event.result.source==job.source and event.result.state in [failed,unavailable,released])

lines.source: scenario void(invoice:Invoice,reason:text) by=finance label="Void invoice"@{nl="Factuur ongeldig maken"}
require can_work(actor,invoice.location) and invoice.state==issued and invoice.received.minor==0 and trim(reason)!=""
if any(invoice.Attempt as attempt,attempt.kind==collection and attempt.status in [pending,unknown])
for attempt in invoice.Attempt as pending where pending.kind==collection and pending.status in [pending,unknown] limit=100
for attempt in Attempt as item where item.reference==event.value.reference limit=1
if attempt.parent.state==void_pending and not any(attempt.parent.Attempt as pending,pending.status in [pending,unknown]) and attempt.parent.received.minor==0
if attempt.kind==collection and event.value.status==failed and attempt.parent.state==issued and attempt.parent.balance.minor>0

send Mail.send {to=attempt.parent.recipient_email,subject=format("Invoice payment needs attention"@{nl="Factuurbetaling vereist aandacht"},locale=null),body=app_url(format("/finance/invoice/{invoice}",{invoice=attempt.parent.id}))} when=attempt.parent.state==issued and attempt.parent.balance.minor>0 and attempt.status==failed as notice

if attempt.mode==automatic and event.value.failure==transient and attempt.parent.consent!=null and attempt.parent.retry_until!=null and now+attempt.parent.retry_delay<=attempt.parent.retry_until and count(attempt.parent.Attempt as previous where previous.kind==collection and previous.mode==automatic)<attempt.parent.attempt_limit
for attempt in Attempt as row where row.delivery==event.delivery_id and row.kind==collection limit=1
if attempt.status in [pending,unknown] and event.status in [failed,unknown]
if attempt.parent.state==void_pending and not any(attempt.parent.Attempt as pending,pending.status in [pending,unknown]) and attempt.parent.received.minor==0
if attempt.parent.state==void_pending and not any(attempt.parent.Attempt as pending,pending.status in [pending,unknown]) and attempt.parent.received.minor==0
for attempt in Attempt as row where row.delivery==event.delivery_id and row.kind==refund limit=1
if attempt.status in [pending,unknown] and event.status in [failed,unknown]
for request in PaymentRequest as row where row.delivery==event.delivery_id and row.kind==cancel limit=1
for request in PaymentRequest as row where row.delivery==event.delivery_id and row.kind==reconcile limit=1
for attempt in Attempt as item where item.status in [pending,unknown] limit=100

if invoice.state==issued and invoice.balance.minor>0 and invoice.consent!=null and invoice.retry_until!=null and now<=invoice.retry_until and not any(BillingCancellation as fence,fence.source==invoice.source)

if not any(invoice.Attempt as attempt,attempt.kind==collection and (attempt.status in [pending,unknown] or (attempt.status==failed and attempt.failure!=transient))) and count(invoice.Attempt as attempt where attempt.kind==collection and attempt.mode==automatic)<invoice.attempt_limit

send Payments.collect {customer=invoice.parent.id,amount=attempt.amount,reference=attempt.reference,consent=invoice.consent} when=invoice.state==issued and invoice.balance==attempt.amount and invoice.consent!=null and not attempt.disabled and invoice.retry_until!=null and now<=invoice.retry_until as delivery

do send Mail.send {to=event.invoice.recipient_email,subject=format("Invoice overdue"@{nl="Factuur achterstallig"},locale=null),body=event.invoice.description+" "+app_url(format("/finance/invoice/{invoice}",{invoice=event.invoice.id}))} when=event.invoice.state==issued and event.invoice.balance.minor>0 as notice
require event.value.amount.minor>=0 and not any(BillingCancellation as fence,fence.source==event.value.source)
let customer=first(Customer as customer where customer.id==event.value.customer order=customer.id)
let location=first(Location as location where location.id==event.value.location order=location.id)

require customer!=null and customer.active and location!=null and location in customer.locations and defaults!=null and defaults.retry_delay>0m and defaults.retry_window>0m and event.value.amount.currency==location.currency
let previous=first(Invoice as invoice where invoice.source==event.value.source order=invoice.id)

require previous.parent==customer and previous.location==location and previous.total==event.value.amount and previous.description==event.value.description and previous.due==event.value.due and previous.consent==event.value.consent and previous.terms==event.value.terms and previous.source_items==event.value.items and (event.value.issuer==null or previous.issuer==event.value.issuer)
require count(event.value.items)>0 and all(event.value.items as item,item.price.currency==location.currency and item.tax.currency==location.currency and item.discount.currency==location.currency)
let invoice=first(Invoice as row where row.source==event.source order=row.id)
for attempt in invoice.Attempt as pending where pending.kind==collection and pending.status in [pending,unknown] limit=100
emit CancelOutcome {value={source=event.source,revision=invoice.ledger_revision,state=unavailable,reference=invoice.id,detail="Collected funds require an evidenced refund"}}

derive eligible_account(person:user,customer:Customer):bool = customer.active and customer.archived_at==null and any(customer.Contact as contact,contact.account==person and contact.verified) and (owns(person,customer) or has_role(person,customer,booker) or has_role(person,customer,administrator))

derive eligible_term(person:user,term:Term,at:datetime):bool = eligible_account(person,term.parent.parent) and not term.parent.paused and not term.parent.revoked and term.paid and term.from<=at and at<term.until and ((term.parent.parent.kind==individual and term.parent.account==person) or any(term.Seat as seat,seat.account==person and seat.active))

derive hours_on(hours:MemberHours,day:date,from:datetime,until:datetime):bool = weekday(day) in hours.weekdays and local_instant(day,hours.opens,hours.timezone,fold=hours.fold)<=from and until<=local_instant(add_days(day,hours.close_after),hours.closes,hours.timezone,fold=hours.fold)

derive permitted_hours(term:Term,location:text,from:datetime,until:datetime):bool = any(term.hours as hours,hours.location==location and (hours_on(hours,local_date(from,hours.timezone),from,until) or hours_on(hours,add_days(local_date(from,hours.timezone),-1),from,until)))

derive balance(allowance:Allowance):decimal = allowance.granted-sum(allowance.Allocation as allocation where allocation.state in [reserved,consumed] select allocation.units)-sum(allowance.Allocation as allocation where allocation.state==staged select allocation.held)

derive Allowance.available:decimal = sum([row] as grant where grant.until>now and grant.parent.paid and not grant.parent.parent.paused and not grant.parent.parent.revoked select balance(grant)) label="Available units"@{nl="Beschikbare eenheden"}

derive Allowance.reserved:decimal = sum(row.Allocation as allocation where allocation.state==reserved select allocation.units)+sum(row.Allocation as allocation where allocation.state==staged select allocation.held) label="Reserved units"@{nl="Gereserveerde eenheden"}
derive Allowance.consumed:decimal = sum(row.Allocation as allocation where allocation.state==consumed select allocation.units) label="Consumed units"@{nl="Verbruikte eenheden"}
derive Allowance.expired:decimal = sum([row] as grant where grant.until<=now select max([0,balance(grant)])) label="Expired units"@{nl="Verlopen eenheden"}

derive access_end(term:Term,location:text,at:datetime):datetime = max(term.hours as hours where hours.location==location select max([at,max(dates(add_days(local_date(at,hours.timezone),-1),add_days(local_date(at,hours.timezone),1),3) as day where hours_on(hours,day,at,at+1ms) select min([term.until,local_instant(add_days(day,hours.close_after),hours.closes,hours.timezone,fold=hours.fold)]))??at]))??at

derive access(watch:AccessWatch):AccessEvidence = AccessEvidence {source=watch.source,customer=watch.parent.id,account=watch.account,location=watch.location.id,until=max([now,max(Term as term where term.parent.parent==watch.parent and watch.location in term.locations and watch.location.active and is_open(watch.location,max([now,watch.at]),max([now,watch.at])+1ms) and eligible_term(watch.account,term,max([now,watch.at])) and access_end(term,watch.location.id,max([now,watch.at]))>max([now,watch.at]) select access_end(term,watch.location.id,max([now,watch.at])))??now]),guest_limit=0,eligible=any(Term as term,term.parent.parent==watch.parent and watch.location in term.locations and watch.location.active and is_open(watch.location,max([now,watch.at]),max([now,watch.at])+1ms) and eligible_term(watch.account,term,max([now,watch.at])) and access_end(term,watch.location.id,max([now,watch.at]))>max([now,watch.at])),revision=watch.revision}

derive busy(b:Booking):bool = b.status in [held,pending,confirmed,occupied] or (b.checked_in!=null and (b.checked_out==null or now<b.checked_out+b.departure_buffer))

derive covers(b:Booking,point:datetime):bool = (count(b.intervals)==0 and b.reserved_from<=point and point<b.reserved_until) or any(b.intervals as interval,interval.from<=point and point<interval.until) or (b.checked_in!=null and b.checked_out==null and b.checked_in<=point) or (b.checked_out!=null and b.checked_out<=point and point<b.checked_out+b.departure_buffer)
derive venue_busy(venue:VenueReservation):bool = venue.status in [held,staged,confirmed] and (venue.status==confirmed or now<venue.expires)

derive venue_covers(venue:VenueReservation,point:datetime):bool = venue.from<=point and point<venue.until and not (venue.previous!=null and venue_busy(venue.previous) and venue.previous.from<=point and point<venue.previous.until)

derive free_at(resource:Resource,point:datetime,quantity:int,skip:Booking?,skip_venue:VenueReservation?=null):bool = quantity+sum(resource.Booking as b where b!=skip and busy(b) and covers(b,point) select b.quantity)+sum(resource.VenueReservation as venue where venue!=skip_venue and venue_busy(venue) and venue_covers(venue,point) select venue.quantity)+sum(resource.QuoteHold as hold where hold.active and now<hold.expires and hold.from<=point and point<hold.until select hold.quantity)+sum(Movement as movement where movement.parent.parent==resource and movement_busy(movement) and movement_covers(movement,point) select movement.parent.quantity)<=resource.capacity

derive free(resource:Resource,from:datetime,until:datetime,quantity:int,skip:Booking?,skip_venue:VenueReservation?=null):bool = resource.active and is_open(resource.location,from,until) and from<until and quantity<=resource.capacity and any(resource.Window as w,not w.closed and w.from<=from and until<=w.until) and not any(resource.Window as w,w.closed and overlaps(from,until,w.from,w.until)) and not any(resource.Downtime as d,d.active and d.from<until and (d.until==null or from<d.until)) and free_at(resource,from,quantity,skip,skip_venue) and all(resource.Booking as b,b==skip or not busy(b) or ((b.reserved_from<from or until<=b.reserved_from or free_at(resource,b.reserved_from,quantity,skip,skip_venue)) and all(b.intervals as interval,interval.from<from or until<=interval.from or free_at(resource,interval.from,quantity,skip,skip_venue)))) and all(resource.VenueReservation as venue,venue==skip_venue or not venue_busy(venue) or venue.from<from or until<=venue.from or free_at(resource,venue.from,quantity,skip,skip_venue)) and all(resource.QuoteHold as hold,not hold.active or hold.expires<=now or hold.from<from or until<=hold.from or free_at(resource,hold.from,quantity,skip,skip_venue)) and all(Movement as movement,movement.parent.parent!=resource or not movement_busy(movement) or all(movement.intervals as interval,interval.from-movement.parent.arrival_buffer<from or until<=interval.from-movement.parent.arrival_buffer or free_at(resource,interval.from-movement.parent.arrival_buffer,quantity,skip,skip_venue)))
derive credit_allowed(customer:Customer,resource:Resource):bool = customer.active and any(customer.BillingProfile as profile,profile.on_account and resource.location in profile.approved_locations)

derive bookable(booking:Booking):bool = (count(booking.intervals)==0 and free(booking.parent,booking.reserved_from,booking.reserved_until,booking.quantity,booking)) or (count(booking.intervals)>0 and all(booking.intervals as interval,free(booking.parent,interval.from,interval.until,booking.quantity,booking)))
derive movement_busy(movement:Movement):bool = movement.state==committing or (movement.state in [holding,waiting_money] and now<movement.expires)

derive movement_covers(movement:Movement,point:datetime):bool = any(movement.intervals as interval,interval.from-movement.parent.arrival_buffer<=point and point<interval.until+movement.parent.departure_buffer) and not (busy(movement.parent) and covers(movement.parent,point))
require VenueReservation: row.from<row.until and row.quantity>0 and (row.previous==null or (row.previous.parent==row.parent and row.quantity==row.previous.quantity))
require QuoteHold: row.from<row.until and row.quantity>0 and row.expires<=row.offer.snapshot.expires
require Assignment: row.from<row.until and row.parent.from<=row.from and row.until<=row.parent.until and row.desk.parent==row.parent.parent

require Resource: row.hourly.currency==row.currency and row.hourly.minor>=0 and row.increment>0m and row.minimum>0m and row.refund_notice>=0m and (row.cancellation_fee==null or (row.cancellation_fee.currency==row.currency and row.cancellation_fee.minor>=0)) and (row.daily==null or (row.daily.currency==row.currency and row.daily.minor>=0)) and (row.price_unit!=day or row.daily!=null) and row.hold_for>0m and row.buffer_before>=0m and row.buffer_after>=0m and (row.pooled or row.capacity==1)

require Booking: row.from<row.until and row.reserved_from<=row.from and row.until<=row.reserved_until and row.total.currency==row.parent.currency and row.total.minor>=0 and row.total==row.subtotal-row.discount+row.tax and row.tax.minor>=0 and row.discount.minor>=0 and row.discount<=row.subtotal and row.refund_amount.currency==row.total.currency and row.refund_amount.minor>=0 and row.refund_amount<=row.total and all(row.intervals as interval,interval.from<interval.until and row.reserved_from<=interval.from and interval.until<=row.reserved_until)

require booking.account==actor and booking.status==confirmed and booking.allowance==consumed and booking.quote==null and booking.checked_in==null and now<booking.refund_before
require not any(booking.Movement as movement,movement.state in [holding,waiting_money,committing,cancelling,review])

let access=booking.parent.DayCalendar as day where start<=day.day and day.day<end and not day.closed order=day.day select BenefitInterval {from=local_instant(day.day,day.opens,booking.parent.timezone,fold=day.fold),until=local_instant(day.day,day.closes,booking.parent.timezone,fold=day.fold)}
for movement in Movement as row where row.reserve_delivery==event.delivery_id limit=1
if event.status==succeeded and event.result!=null and event.result.source==movement.source
for movement in Movement as row where row.commit_delivery==event.delivery_id limit=1
if event.status==succeeded and event.result!=null and event.result.source==movement.source
for movement in Movement as row where row.source==event.value.source limit=1
if event.value.phase==staged and event.value.state==confirmed and movement.state in [holding,waiting_money]
require event.value.unit==booking.benefit_unit and event.value.duration==booking.benefit_duration and event.value.rate==(booking.benefit_rate ?? booking.rate)

if now<booking.refund_before and now<movement.expires and booking.status==confirmed and booking.checked_in==null and all(movement.intervals as interval,free(booking.parent,interval.from-booking.arrival_buffer,interval.until+booking.departure_buffer,0,null))
create Adjustment {parent=booking,source=movement.source,amount=extra,reason="Membership movement overage",movement} as adjustment

send Billing.charge {value={source=movement.source,customer=booking.customer.id,location=booking.parent.location.id,description="Membership movement overage",amount=extra,due=local_date(at(movement.intervals,0).from,booking.parent.timezone),terms=booking.terms,items=[DocumentLine {title="Workspace movement balance",quantity=1,price=event.value.overage-(booking.allowance_base ?? booking.subtotal),discount=discount-(booking.allowance_discount ?? booking.discount),tax=tax-(booking.allowance_tax ?? booking.tax),unit="adjustment",from=at(movement.intervals,0).from,until=at(movement.intervals,count(movement.intervals)-1).until,location=booking.parent.location.name,reference=movement.source}]}} as charge
if event.value.phase==consumed and event.value.state==confirmed and movement.state==committing

if booking.status==confirmed and booking.checked_in==null and all(movement.intervals as interval,free(booking.parent,interval.from-booking.arrival_buffer,interval.until+booking.departure_buffer,0,null))

for movement in Movement as row where row.source==event.value.source limit=1

require can_work(actor,movement.parent.parent.location) and movement.state==adopted and movement.credit_due!=null and amount.currency==movement.credit_due.currency and amount.minor>0 and trim(reason)!=""

require all(event.value.snapshot.lines as item,item.quantity>=0 and (item.quantity>0 or item.price*item.quantity+item.tax-item.discount==money(0,item.price.currency)) and item.price.currency==resource.currency and item.tax.currency==resource.currency and item.discount.currency==resource.currency and item.price.minor>=0 and item.tax.minor>=0 and item.discount.minor>=0 and item.discount<=item.price*item.quantity+item.tax)

derive dated_open(location:Location,day:date,from:datetime,until:datetime):bool = any(location.DateHours as hours,hours.day==day and not hours.closed and local_instant(day,hours.opens,location.timezone,fold=hours.fold)<=from and until<=local_instant(add_days(day,hours.close_after),hours.closes,location.timezone,fold=hours.fold)) or (not any(location.DateHours as hours,hours.day==day) and any(location.WeeklyHours as hours,hours.weekday==weekday(day) and local_instant(day,hours.opens,location.timezone,fold=hours.fold)<=from and until<=local_instant(add_days(day,hours.close_after),hours.closes,location.timezone,fold=hours.fold)))

export derive is_open(location:Location,from:datetime,until:datetime):bool = location.active and from<until and all(dates(local_date(from,location.timezone),add_days(local_date(until-1ms,location.timezone),1)) as day,not any(location.ClosedDate as holiday,holiday.day==day) and not any(location.DateHours as hours,hours.day==day and hours.closed)) and any(dates(add_days(local_date(from,location.timezone),-1),add_days(local_date(until,location.timezone),1)) as day,dated_open(location,day,from,until))
